title: Steamed Slovakian Spaghetti
description: A hearty and comforting Slovakian-inspired spaghetti dish, steamed to perfection.

ingredients.name: Slovakian Seasoning
ingredients.notes: a mix of paprika, garlic, and caraway seeds

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Stir in the Slovakian seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked spaghetti to the skillet and toss with the mushroom mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the spaghetti to a serving dish and garnish with parsley.
